notes.title: v1.0.3 Patch
notes.notes: [h3][b]Additions[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Invert mouse look settings (Vertical and horizontal)[/p][/*][*][p]Invert change slot setting[/p][/*][*][p]Click chat messages to copy their user ID[/p][/*][*][p]Click players in the scoreboard to copy their user ID[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Changes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Reduced the amount of XP required to gain levels (Your current level will increase)[/p][/*][*][p]Gamemode XP can now be fully earned while playing with bots[/p][/*][*][p]Level cosmetic unlock order adjusted (First 10 levels)[/p][/*][*][p]Chat messages now persist when changing maps[/p][/*][*][p]“No Bots” vote denominator now represents the amount of votes required to remove bots[/p][/*][*][p]“Ready” vote denominator now represents the amount of votes required to start the game[/p][/*][/list][h3]Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Long usernames cut-off in kill confirmed text[/p][/*][*][p]Lobby countdown sometimes stopped[/p][/*][*][p]Loading doesn’t immediately start when joining a server[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: v1.0.2 Patch
notes.notes: [h3][b]Additions[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Setting to invert the flash screen effect (white to black)[/p][/*][*][p]Max bots lobby setting[/p][/*][*][p]Scope crosshair size setting[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Changes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Your “No Bots” vote will now persist between games[/p][/*][*][p]The max amount of bots will now default to 12 (Before it was the servers max player count)[/p][/*][*][p]Ammo pickups now refill throwables (3rd hand slot)[/p][/*][*][p]Increased new chat message display time from 2.22 to 5 seconds[/p][/*][*][p]Flash improvements[/p][list][*][p]Reduced flash effect max range from 60 to 30[/p][/*][*][p]Removed the ringing sound[/p][/*][*][p]Low pass filter for the audio effect[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3]Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Issues that caused the server to freeze/crash[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: v1.0.1 Patch
notes.notes: [h1][b]Patch v1.0.1[/b][/h1][hr][/hr][h2]Additions[/h2][list][*][p]New main menu and lobby music composed by [url="https://dubscr.com/"]Dubscr[/url][/p][/*][/list][h2]Changes[/h2][list][*][p]Empty player slots are now populated with bots by default when in game[/p][/*][*][p]Vote "No Bots" in the lobby to remove bots from the next game (Requires 20% vote count)[/p][/*][*][p]"Auto Vault" controls setting is now off by default[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: X-Mode 1.0 Release
notes.notes: [h1][b]Update v1.0.0[/b][/h1][hr][/hr][p]After [b]5 years[/b] of development X-Mode will be available free-to-play [b]September 19th[/b]![/p][h2]Additions[/h2][list][*][p]World space capture point names[/p][/*][*][p]Flag stolen UI in Capture The Flag gamemode[/p][/*][*][p]Grass render distance setting[/p][/*][*][p]“Aim Time” item info UI[/p][/*][*][p]Idle players will be kicked after [b]idleKickTime[/b] server property (Default 60 seconds)[/p][/*][*][p]Per player voice chat mute[/p][/*][*][p][b]/help[/b] command that lists all available commands[/p][/*][/list][h2]Changes[/h2][list][*][p]Mountain Temple map has been fully detailed[/p][/*][*][p]Recoil adjustments[/p][list][*][p]Reduced recoil on all automatic guns[/p][/*][*][p]Gun recoil is no longer increased while moving[/p][/*][*][p]Gun recoil spring back amount now adjusts to compensation from player input[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Increased other player footstep volume[/p][/*][*][p]Race checkpoint numbers are now visible through walls[/p][/*][*][p]Increased proximity chat distance[/p][/*][*][p][b]timeoutTime[/b] server property time unit changed from milliseconds to seconds[/p][/*][*][p]Improved cosmetic progress screen UI[/p][/*][/list][h2]Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Elimination border appeared when it shouldn’t[/p][/*][*][p]Physics objects not affected by lifts/jump pads[/p][/*][*][p]Player level in scoreboard didn’t increase between rounds after levelling up[/p][/*][*][p]Rare chance that players were unable to move after respawn[/p][/*][*][p]Issues with server console input on Linux[/p][/*][*][p]Throwables would appear to begin throwing but fail if item is still equipping[/p][/*][*][p]Issues with setting slider fields[/p][/*][/list]
